description: This Java class handles the command to waive interest on a loan. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and uses the 'LoanWritePlatformService' to perform the waiver operation. The class is annotated as a Spring service and is tied to the command type 'LOAN' with the action 'WAIVEINTERESTPORTION'.

classes.name: WaiveInterestPortionOnLoanCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the 'waive interest portion' command for loans, invoking the related service to perform the operation.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to waive interest, delegating to the loan write platform service.
